QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Forgetfulness
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9010010##k says she forgot to tell you something, and wants you to come to her immediately... What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1: #p9010010# has a message she forgot to deliver. She wants you to find #b#p2101018##k, but she didn't know where to go? The name kind of sounds like someone from #m260000000#... Try looking in #b#m102000000##k, #b#m260000000##k, #b#m100000000##k, #b#m220000000##k, or #b#m120000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2101018# was just standing there grim-faced, holding a spear... It looked like trouble.

0.0: Whaaat?! Oh, no! This can't be good! I can't believe that I, #p9010010#, master organizer of Maple World, have made such a mistake! Oh, the tragedy! The drama! What? What's going on, you ask?
0.1: Something special is going on at #b#m260000000##k. But I completely forgot to tell others about it! And now there are way too many people who aren't aware of what's going on! Oh, dear...
0.2: I should spring into action! Judging by your level, you seem to fit the requirements. So, what are you waiting for? Go find #b#p2101018##k!

yes.0: What? Who is this #p2101018#, you ask? I don't have time to explain such things! Hurry and go! Oh yeah, I still haven't told you were #p2101018# could be! You're bound to find #p2101018# at either #b#m260000000##k, #b#m102000000##k, #b#m100000000##k, #b#m220000000##k, or #b#m120000000##k! So hurry and go!

no.0: What? Are you saying you don't want to head over to #p2101018#? Well, if you don't want to I guess I can't force you... Hmph! Then get out of my way! There are plenty of others I can bring this news to!

npc.0: You still haven't gone to meet #b#p2101018##k? I told you, you could probably find him at #b#m260000000##k, #b#m102000000##k, #b#m100000000##k, #b#m220000000##k, or #b#m120000000##k!
